description: Pull existing Sentry issues into Mushi's report queue: by issueIds (numeric ids or short ids like WEB-12, at most 10) or by a Sentry search query (default is:unresolved) within the project's configured Sentry project, limit 1-10. For a backlog, add sinceDays (1-90) and call again with cursor set to the returned nextCursor until it is null; sentryProject picks another of the project's Sentry projects. Each issue goes through the same path as a Sentry webhook delivery: deduped per issue, linked, classified. An issue already linked to a report answers linked and is never reopened. Returns { items: [{ input, issueId, shortId, outcome, reportId, error? }], created, linked, failed, indexing, sentryProject, sentryProjects, nextCursor }. Write; idempotent; spends classification budget per new report. Needs the Sentry org slug, project slug and an auth token (event:read, project:read) in Integrations → Sentry. Use for issues that existed before the webhook was wired; then call triage_issue on a created report.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous import, to fetch the next page of a backlog. Search mode only.

issueIds.description: Sentry issue ids or short ids (e.g. "4501", "WEB-12"), at most 10

limit.description: How many issues a query imports (1-10, default 5)

projectId.description: Project UUID. Defaults to configured project. (`project_id` is accepted too.)

query.description: Sentry search query within the configured Sentry project (default is:unresolved). Not with issueIds.

sentryProject.description: Which of the project's Sentry projects to search (default: the primary one). Search mode only.

sinceDays.description: Only issues seen in the last N days (1-90). Search mode only.

name: import_sentry_issues

created.description: Report ids created by this import

failed.description: Issues that could not be imported

indexing.description: Whether stack-frame files were queued for codebase indexing

items.description: One entry per requested or matched issue

linked.description: Report ids that already existed for these issues

nextCursor.description: Pass back as cursor to import the next page; null when the backlog is done

sentryProject.description: The Sentry project a search ran in (null for issueIds)

sentryProjects.description: This project's Sentry projects, primary first

title: Import Sentry issues
